g.text: The water-vs-land scene swing is the same for both classes (2.14 vs. 2.18 logits
at scale 0.5); the error asymmetry comes from CLIP's default, which leans
'waterbird': a small landbird on plain gray already gets s = +0.44
Water score s (→ 'waterbird'). (a) 10 water and 10 land plates relative to the same bird on gray, and the
absolute s on gray (dotted). (b) s on water plates − s on land plates, same bird and scale. 95% CIs resample
